response.justification: The candidate is a highly experienced and versatile software engineer, but his profile is a significant mismatch for the core requirements of this C++ developer role. His professional C++ experience is limited to a single, brief engagement nearly a decade ago. The vast majority of his career has been focused on web technologies (TypeScript, Node.js) and DLang, not the modern C++, multi-threading, and secure development practices required. He also lacks any stated experience in the industrial automation domain or with the specified security standard IEC 62443.
strengths: Extensive experience as a senior software engineer across a wide range of technologies.
Demonstrates strong initiative through founding projects, creating libraries, and leading workshops.
Experience with performance-oriented development (DLang) and event-driven architectures.
concerns: Virtually no recent or substantial professional C++ development experience.
Lacks any mentioned experience with industrial automation, IoT protocols, or required security standards (IEC 62443).
Primary expertise is in web development (JavaScript/TypeScript, Node.js), which is not the focus of the role.
